// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/built-ins/ArrayBuffer/proto-from-ctor-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

var o = Reflect.construct(ArrayBuffer, [], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(o), other.ArrayBuffer.prototype);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/DataView/proto-from-ctor-realm-sab.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// Copyright (C) 2017 Mozilla Corporation. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;
var buffer = new SharedArrayBuffer(0);

var o = Reflect.construct(DataView, [buffer, 0], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(o), other.DataView.prototype);
})();
